votes.evidence_summary: REST upsert accepts multiple incorrect types with silent coercion: string to DOUBLE, string and int to BOOL, string to INT16, violating strict type constraints
votes.rationale: four Type1 violations: the system should reject type mismatches for strongly-typed scalar fields but instead accepts and coerces incorrect types (string for DOUBLE, string/int for BOOL, string for INT16), returning success when it should enforce strict type validation
